Designed for boundary-aware discovery

A hub, six origins, a connected world.

The index is a stable starting URL. Each edition link crosses to its own publication host, while sibling relationships expose additional routes through the network. The manifest records origins, article counts, hub links and sister edges without duplicating every article.
